title: Retrieval Supersedes Scale: Efficient Log Level Prediction via Multiplex Socio-Technical Context
abstract: arXiv:2611.05901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developers insert logging statements in source code to record its execution, and the resulting logs are essential for detecting and troubleshooting system anomalies. A key part of these statements is the log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), which determines whether a message is recorded. Choosing it is a trade-off: levels set too low mask important information in production, while levels set too high create noisy logs and extra I/O and storage overhead. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) with In-Context Learning (ICL) to predict log levels, but typically augments the prompt with randomly sampled examples. We argue that this overlooks the socio-technical nature of logging, where conventions vary by component and development team. translated_title: 检索超越规模：基于多重社会技术上下文的高效日志级别预测
translated_abstract: 开发者在源代码中插入日志语句以记录程序执行过程，由此产生的日志对于检测和排查系统异常至关重要。这些语句的关键组成部分是日志级别（如 DEBUG、INFO、WARN、ERROR），它决定了消息是否被记录。选择日志级别是一种权衡：级别设置过低会掩盖生产环境中的重要信息，而级别设置过高则会产生冗余日志并带来额外的 I/O 和存储开销。近期研究采用大语言模型（LLM）结合上下文学习（ICL）来预测日志级别，但通常使用随机采样的示例来扩充提示词。我们认为这种做法忽视了日志编写的社会技术属性，即日志约定会因组件和开发团队的不同而存在差异。据报道，使用随机示例的现成 LLM 仅能达到 0.56 到 0.76 的中位 AUC，这表明无需微调仍有改进空间。在本文中，我们提出了一种检索方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于多重社会技术上下文的检索方法来选择上下文学习示例，从而在不微调的情况下显著提升 LLM 的日志级别预测效果，证明了检索策略优于单纯依赖模型规模。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a retrieval-based approach that leverages multiplex socio-technical context to select in-context learning examples, substantially improving LLM-based log level prediction without fine-tuning, demonstrating that retrieval supersedes scale.
